from solution import neighbor_products
assert neighbor_products('2,-3,4') == '-6,-12'
assert neighbor_products('7') == ''
assert neighbor_products('-1000,1000') == '-1000000'
assert neighbor_products('1,+2') is None
assert neighbor_products('') is None
